- R4 (B‑N_b3) = 20 Ω
- R3 (N_b3‑N_b2) = 15 Ω
- R2 (N_b2‑N_b1) = 10 Ω
- R1 (N_b1‑X1) = 5 Ω

This uses exactly four resistors as required and matches all measured resistances.</thought>
